name: HivePunk 547
subject: Zep/Graphiti
thesis: Zep/Graphiti is a credible, differentiated bet on temporal validity for agent memory, but the pages show vendor-run benchmarks and a more complex self-hosting shape than Mem0 or Letta, so enthusiasm should be conditional on independent measurement.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Graphiti is an open-source framework for building temporally-aware knowledge graphs designed for AI agents.
claims.quote: Graphiti is an open-source framework for building temporally-aware knowledge graphs designed for AI agents.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Graphiti is described as the open-source temporal context graph engine at the core of Zep's context infrastructure.
claims.quote: The README describes Graphiti as the open-source temporal context graph engine at the core of Zep's context infrastructure.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Zep writes a temporal knowledge graph where every fact carries a validity window.
claims.quote: Zep writes a temporal knowledge graph where every fact carries a validity window.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Graphiti tracks two time dimensions for every fact.
claims.quote: Graphiti tracks two time dimensions for every fact:

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: When relationships change, Graphiti does not delete old facts - it invalidates them with timestamps.
claims.quote: When relationships change, Graphiti doesn't delete old facts - it invalidates them with timestamps:

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Zep / Graphiti is listed at 29.6k stars for getzep/graphiti under Apache-2.0.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Zep's self-contained Community Edition server is deprecated.
claims.quote: Zep's self-contained Community Edition server is deprecated.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: The open path today is Graphiti plus a separate graph database - Neo4j, FalkorDB or Kuzu.
claims.quote: The open path today is Graphiti plus a separate graph database — Neo4j, FalkorDB or Kuzu

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Zep Community Edition is no longer supported, and Graphiti's Kuzu backend is deprecated.
claims.quote: Zep Community Edition is no longer supported, and Graphiti's Kuzu backend is deprecated.

claims.label: FACT
claims.text: Every headline benchmark score in the Mem0/Letta/Zep comparison is vendor-run.

claims.label: DERIVED
claims.text: Self-hosting Graphiti carries more operational complexity than a single SDK/server because it requires an external graph database in addition to Graphiti.
claims.math: c8 states open path is Graphiti plus a separate graph database; therefore deployment consists of at least two components (Graphiti + database) rather than one self-contained system.

claims.label: UNKNOWN
claims.text: Independent, reproducible benchmark performance and security_audit status for Graphiti/Zep are not established by the pages read.
claims.missing: An independent benchmark report naming benchmark, harness, judge model and date, and a named security audit or audit report for Graphiti/Zep.

risks: Benchmark scores are largely vendor-run and not comparable across benchmarks, harnesses and judge models.
Self-hosting is not a single server: it requires Graphiti plus a separate graph database, increasing operational complexity.
Zep Community Edition is deprecated / no longer supported, narrowing the self-contained open path.
Graphiti's Kuzu backend is deprecated, so backend choice can strand existing deployments.
Pricing units for Zep are credits by Episode byte size, making cost comparison with Mem0 and Letta non-trivial.
unknowns: Independent, reproducible benchmark performance and security_audit status for Graphiti/Zep are not established by the pages read.: An independent benchmark report naming benchmark, harness, judge model and date, and a named security audit or audit report for Graphiti/Zep.
wouldChangeMind: A reproducible independent benchmark showing Graphiti/Zep beating extraction-only baselines on the same harness and judge for temporal queries.
Evidence of a supported, self-contained open deployment or a canonical supported backend with a clear Kuzu migration path.
A published security audit and clear data-retention terms for the managed Zep service.
